title: Govt moves to make school safety a priority
desc: The government is preparing to make school safety a national priority, with the Education Ministry due to submit six measures to the cabinet today following last week's shooting at Debsirin Nonthaburi School.
title_cn: 政府将学校安全列为国家优先事项
summary_cn: 继上周暖武里府（Nonthaburi）德布西林学校（Debsirin）枪击事件后，泰国政府采取行动确保学校安全。教育部将于今日向内阁提交六项安全措施，旨在建立更完善的学校保护机制。
desc_original: The government is preparing to make school safety a national priority, with the Education Ministry due to submit six measures to the cabinet today following last week's shooting at Debsirin Nonthaburi School.

title: Travel subsidy nears launch
desc: The Tourism and Sports Ministry expects to finalise details of the proposed Thai Tiew Thai Plus domestic tourism subsidy scheme by next week as it seeks to launch the programme during the green (monsoon) season, Minister Surasak Phancharoenworakul said.
title_cn: 国内旅游补贴计划即将推出
summary_cn: 泰国旅游体育部长苏拉萨克表示，「泰国之旅 Plus」国内旅游补贴计划预计下周敲定细节，计划在绿季（季风季）期间正式启动，旨在刺激国内旅游需求。
desc_original: The Tourism and Sports Ministry expects to finalise details of the proposed Thai Tiew Thai Plus domestic tourism subsidy scheme by next week as it seeks to launch the programme during the green (monsoon) season, Minister Surasak Phancharoenworakul said.

title: Finance plan to help local communities
desc: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has approved a 4.45-billion-baht programme to provide cheaper financing to grassroots communities and reduce their reliance on high-interest informal loans.
title_cn: 政府推出 44.5 亿泰铢融资计划扶持基层社区
summary_cn: 总理阿努廷·詹维拉库尔批准一项 44.5 亿泰铢的计划，向基层社区提供低息融资，帮助民众减少对高利率非正规贷款的依赖，旨在改善农村金融生态。
desc_original: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has approved a 4.45-billion-baht programme to provide cheaper financing to grassroots communities and reduce their reliance on high-interest informal loans.

title: B3,000 minimum monthly bill for solar panel subsidy
desc: To qualify for the government subsidy for installing rooftop solar panels, households must have a minimum monthly electricity bill of around 3,000 baht, according to the Finance Ministry.
title_cn: 屋顶太阳能补贴最低月电费需 3000 泰铢
summary_cn: 泰国财务部公布屋顶太阳能安装补贴资格要求，家庭月度电费账单需达 3000 泰铢以上才能申请政府补贴。该政策旨在鼓励家庭转向清洁能源，降低长期能源成本。
desc_original: To qualify for the government subsidy for installing rooftop solar panels, households must have a minimum monthly electricity bill of around 3,000 baht, according to the Finance Ministry.

title: US-Japan move to stop yen slide helps baht appreciate
desc: A US-Japan joint intervention to stop the yen's slide is among the reasons the baht has appreciated beyond 33 baht to the dollar, economists say, noting that the Thai currency is likely to continue gaining against the greenback in the near term.
title_cn: 美日联手稳定日元，推高泰铢升值
summary_cn: 美国与日本联合干预稳定日元跌势，成为泰铢升值的重要推动因素。泰铢已升值至1美元兑30多铢的水平，突破关键位置。经济学家指出这一汇率变动主要源于国际外汇市场动态和美日政策协调。短期内泰铢有望继续走强，这对在泰外国人购买力有一定提升，也影响进出口贸易成本。
desc_original: A US-Japan joint intervention to stop the yen's slide is among the reasons the baht has appreciated beyond 33 baht to the dollar, economists say, noting that the Thai currency is likely to continue gaining against the greenback in the near term.

title: Anutin slams police treatment of suspect in PAO chief killing
desc: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul ordered the Nonthaburi governor and provincial police chief to take decisive action in the case of former MP Chalong Riewraeng allegedly shooting dead Nonthaburi Provincial Administrative Organisation (PAO) president Pol Col Thongchai Yenprasert.
title_cn: 阿努廷下令严查暖武里府长命案
summary_cn: 总理阿努廷（Anutin Charnvirakul）对警方在暖武里府（Nonthaburi）长官遭害案件中的处理表示不满，已下令府长和省警察局采取果断行动。前议员差隆（Chalong Riewraeng）涉嫌枪杀暖武里府行政组织主席通差上校（Pol Col Thongchai Yenprasert）。此案涉及高层人员伤亡和执法问题，引起政府高层直接介入和公众关注，反映出司法系统的执行力问题。
desc_original: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul ordered the Nonthaburi governor and provincial police chief to take decisive action in the case of former MP Chalong Riewraeng allegedly shooting dead Nonthaburi Provincial Administrative Organisation (PAO) president Pol Col Thongchai Yenprasert.

title: Migrant workers fill restaurant gap
desc: The online debate over whether restaurants in Thailand should accept orders only in Thai highlights an underlying issue in the industry: a persistent labour shortage, as many Thais do not want to work in the sector.
title_cn: 外来移工成为泰国餐饮业人手补充的关键
summary_cn: 泰国餐饮业因本地劳动力短缺而依赖外来移工。网络中围绕餐厅是否应仅接受泰语点餐的讨论，本质反映出行业面临的深层问题：许多泰国人不愿从事餐饮服务工作。外来移工正在填补这一长期存在的用工空缺，成为维持行业运营的重要力量，这反映了泰国就业市场的结构性变化和劳动力构成转变。
desc_original: The online debate over whether restaurants in Thailand should accept orders only in Thai highlights an underlying issue in the industry: a persistent labour shortage, as many Thais do not want to work in the sector.

title: BoT targets cash buyers of property
desc: The Bank of Thailand is planning to require banks to scrutinise customers who buy high-value property with cash as part of efforts to prevent illicit financial activities.
title_cn: 泰央行加强现金购房交易监管
summary_cn: 泰国央行（Bank of Thailand, BoT）计划要求商业银行强化对现金购买高价地产客户的审查和监督。这是防止非法金融活动、打击洗钱和资金来源不明的重要举措。新规定将提高购房交易的透明度和合规性要求，对所有大额现金购房客户产生影响，也涉及房地产市场监管、金融合规和外汇管制等多个层面。
desc_original: The Bank of Thailand is planning to require banks to scrutinise customers who buy high-value property with cash as part of efforts to prevent illicit financial activities.

title: Call for more help for illegal Phuket hotels
desc: Phuket tourism operators are urging the Interior Ministry to extend the tourism clinic programme, which offers consultations to help illegal accommodation operators comply with the law, as well as extend the expired ministerial regulation that allows other building types to register as hotels while awaiting the new Hotel Act.
title_cn: 普吉岛旅游业呼吁延续违规酒店合规扶持
summary_cn: 普吉岛旅游业者敦促内政部延长「旅游诊所」计划的执行期限，该计划为非法经营的住宿设施提供咨询服务，帮助其完成合规转变。同时呼吁延续已过期的部长令规定，允许其他建筑类型在新《饭店法》立法完成前临时注册为酒店。这些政策调整涉及旅游业的运营环境、住宿供应和外国游客的住宿体验。

title: 泰国上半年网诈损失近90亿泰铢 消费者呼吁平台担责
desc: 泰国头条新闻社 据泰媒报道，2026年前6个月，泰国民众因网络诈骗遭受的损失金额接近90亿泰铢。同期共发生超过17万起网络诈骗案件，平均每起案件损失超过5.2万泰铢。 这一数据表明，网络诈骗正逐渐演变为影响广泛的经济和社会问题。尤其值得关注的是，诈骗分子越来越多地利用民众日常使用的数字平台实施诈骗。 泰国消费者组织委员会公布的数据显示，2026年1月至6月期间，脸书（Facebook）是网络诈骗案件最多的渠道，占全部案件的61%以上。诈骗形式包括创建虚假主页、假账户、发布虚假投资广告、网络购物诈骗，以及冒充个人或政府机构等。 相比之下，LINE平台发生的案件数量虽然低于脸书，但造成的损失总额却与脸书相近。这反映出网络诈骗并非局限于某一个平台，而是已经形成覆盖广告发布、线上交流、诱导受骗以及资金转账等多个环节的数字犯罪链条。 面对不断增加的网络诈骗损失，泰国消费者组织委员会与受害者已开始对相关网络平台及金融机构提起诉讼。 相关案件源于消费者通过网络渠道遭遇投资诈骗。消费者组织方面针对银行提出诉讼，涉及违反服务合同、违反存款合同以及侵犯消费者权益等问题。 这起诉讼的目的不仅是为首批10名受害者争取赔偿，更希望通过司法程序回答一个更大的问题：数字平台及相关服务提供商究竟应该在多大程度上对消费者的网络安全承担责任。 泰国消费者组织委员会秘书长莎丽表示，法院已决定推迟开庭日期，原因是部分被告申请延长提交答辩状的期限，另有部分被告依法就案件管辖权提出上诉，认为该案不属于消费者案件。消费者组织委员会将继续依法推进相关诉讼。 她表示，此次诉讼并非仅仅为了赔偿受害者，更希望推动整个行业发生系统性改变，避免其他消费者再次成为诈骗受害者。 消费者组织方面提出的主要建议之一，是要求数字平台加强主动防范措施，包括筛查和拦截虚假诈骗广告，利用人工智能（AI）技术识别涉嫌诈骗的文字内容及投资诱导行为，同时加强对App Store和Play Store应用程序的审核，阻止诈骗分子利用虚假应用程序欺骗民众。 泰国消费者组织委员会主席汶育表示，此次诉讼旨在建立消费者权益保护方面的责任标准，而不是为了制造舆论或提升组织知名度。 她指出，目前大量消费者已经难以判断数字平台上出现的广告、信息和账户究竟是真实信息还是诈骗内容，而数字平台仍是诈骗分子接触大量受害者的重要渠道。 因此，消费者组织委员会将继续全力推进相关案件，推动服务提供商承担相应责任，并从长远角度建立消费者网络安全保障机制。 网络诈骗并不只是通过创建虚假主页实施，另一个导致受害者资金被迅速转移的重要环节是所谓的“马甲账户”，即被诈骗团伙用于收取和转移赃款的银行账户。 泰国数字经济与社会部部长猜差诺表示，目前正在推进的重要措施之一是制定各类“马甲账户”名单认定标准。该措施由数字经济与社会部、泰国央行、泰国反洗钱办公室（AMLO）以及泰国银行

title: Years of dog poisonings on Koh Phangan beach remain unsolved
desc: Years of dog poisonings on Koh Phangan beach remain unsolved Legacy Animal welfare groups on Koh Phangan are warning residents after a suspected poisoning incident left multiple dogs dead and others hospitalised on Ban Tai Beach, the latest in a series of similar incidents reported in the same area since at least 2022. According to posts from local animal welfare pages, poison was found hidden inside pieces of chicken meat left along the beach. Phangan Hug Satt Animal Clinic said it had received multiple poisoned dogs on the day of the incident, and residents were advised to keep pets on a leash, avoid letting them scavenge, and seek immediate veterinary treatment if they showed signs of poisoning, including bleeding from the mouth or nose, vomiting, lethargy or paralysis. A reader submission sent to The Thaiger, along with screenshots from local Facebook community groups dating back to 2022, describes a recurring pattern of poisonings on the same stretch of coastline, affecting stray animals as well as pets belonging to residents and tourists. Community members estimate more than 50 dogs have died this way over the years, though this figure has not been independently verified. Pos

summary_cn: 攀牙岛（Koh Phangan）班泰海滩（Ban Tai Beach）自2022年来反复发生狗只中毒事件，嫌犯用有毒鸡肉投放沙滩引诱动物食用。动物福利组织估计已有超过50条狗因此丧生，包括流浪犬和居民宠物，案件至今未破，下毒者身份不明。

summary_cn: 泰国吉萨库尔（Chitssakul）家族投资十亿泰铢，在清莱（Chiang Rai）开设格雷韦迪清莱瑞吉酒店（Khahvadee Chiang Rai Curio Collection by Hilton），这是泰国北部地区首家希尔顿（Hilton）品牌酒店。项目位于格河（Mae Kok River）沿岸，以传统北方建筑风格与现代设施相融合，旨在提升清莱在国际旅游地图中的地位，促进当地旅游经济发展。

title: 泰国旅游政策两连击！国内游发补贴，外国游客拟缴“入境费“
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 8月10日，泰国旅游与体育部长素拉萨出席“贸易、旅游与社区经济发展小组委员会”2569年度会议。会议由副总理兼商业部长素帕琪主持，文化部长萨比达及相关部门代表出席，共同为旅游业及服务业经济发展划定政策框架。 会上，素拉萨提出通过旅游业刺激经济的重要举措，重点围绕增强安全信心、开发二线城市“宜游城市”旅游景点，以及推动可持续旅游惠及基层社区等方面展开。 在刺激国内旅游方面，该部推出“Thai Teaw Thai Plus”项目，以共付形式实施，系根据私营部门建议制定，重点支持餐饮以外的旅游服务消费，通过泰国Krungthai银行“Pao Tang”应用程序发放。项目初步预算为17.5亿泰铢，共设50万个名额，每人限5个名额，政府补贴50%，每名额补贴不超过3000泰铢。 目前，旅游与体育部正与财政部磋商预算来源及具体条件，力争在“绿色季节”期间启动，使经营者最大程度受益。与以往相比，本次项目将代金券金额从每名额500泰铢提高至1000泰铢，使用范围从仅限餐厅扩大至全国各类旅游相关消费，包括餐厅、景点参观、旅游商品购买、社区产品、导游服务及租车等。素拉萨表示，该项目100%将推出，所有参与方均确认其有效性，预计第一阶段于今年9月启动，实施期为4个月。若反响良好，政府将在后续阶段延续该项目，预计将为经济体系注入超过260亿泰铢资金。 此外，会上还讨论了向入境外国游客征收费用的方案。相关资金将注入泰国旅游促进基金，主要用于三个方面：开发既有及二线城市新建人造景点；作为保险费为游客提供安全保障；修复和恢复受旅游影响的自然环境。旅游与体育部将与由威拉萨任主席的创意经济及访客经济工作组密切合作，在副总理素帕琪要求的6个月至1年内实现“Quick Win”快速成效目标。工作重点将放在解除阻碍旅游业发展的规章束缚、提升竞争力，无需等待法律修订。 素拉萨表示，此次工作是政府与私营部门的协同整合，旨在调整泰国旅游经济结构，使其更加稳健和可持续。预计下周将就旅游刺激项目得出明确结论，以确保各方准备工作及时到位。 （编译：Wan；来源：Thansettakij） The post 泰国旅游政策两连击！国内游发补贴，外国游客拟缴“入境费“ appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .
title_cn: 泰国旅游政策「双管齐下」：国内游补贴与外国游客入境费并行

title: Foreigners say they were advised into nominee scheme by law firms
desc: Foreigners say they were advised into nominee scheme by law firms Legacy Police arrested 13 foreigners during a crackdown on a nominee network today, August 10, after they were found to be illegally owning pool villas and properties in Hua Hin, Prachuap Khiri Khan, through a nominee scheme. More than 200 police and government officials launched an operation named “Crackdown on Foreign Nominee Networks Phase 6” targeting houses and pool villas in Thap Thai subdistrict, Hua Hin district, Prachuap Khiri Khan. Each property was reportedly valued at about 10 million to 20 million baht. Investigators identified six companies connected to the properties and found that the companies were registered using Thai nationals as nominees. Following the investigation, police obtained arrest warrants for 45 foreign nationals and summonses for 39 Thai nationals. title: 泰国多校加强校园安检，严防武器入校
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 8月10日，泰国暖武里府多所学校在Debsirin Nonthaburi学校枪击案发生后，全面升级校园安全措施，自校门口起对学生书包进行抽查，并使用金属探测扫描仪查找违禁物品，严防武器进入校园。 此前，8月7日上午，Debsirin Nonthaburi学校发生一起严重枪击事件。一名14岁初三男生在偷枪射杀其祖父母后，携带枪支进入校园扫射，随后畏罪自杀。该事件共造成9人死亡，其中包括6名学校教职员工、其祖父母及作案者本人。案件发生后，警方正加紧核查事实、调查作案动机。 8月10日，记者走访位于暖武里府赛诺县塔维瓦塔纳乡的瓦玛颂米塔帕55学校。该校为幼儿园至初中三年级一贯制学校，共有学生440人。记者发现，学校已在学生进入教室前设置检查点，由教师对书包及随身物品进行逐一排查。校长克里昂克莱表示，学校此前曾发生零星学生争吵及霸凌事件，校方始终重视学生安全，定期举办反霸凌工作坊、网络安全培训及道德教育活动。此次枪击案发生后，学校进一步强化了安检措施。 位于暖武里府勐县塔赛乡的本乍马拉差努颂学校同样加强了安检力度。该校由教师、警员及家长代表共同组成检查队伍，先对书包进行检查，再使用金属探测设备对学生身体进行复查。校长南塔纳表示，校方已与学生事务部门协调落实安全措施。学生事务助理副校长瓦提功介绍，学校一直以来对携带武器和毒品保持严查，此次事件后进一步升级检查标准，除进校前检查外，还将在教室内开展不定期抽查。目前该校共有学生2400人，叻他那铁贴警局警员及家长网络已协助参与检查，初期将连续严查约7至8天，随后转为针对高风险学生群体进行重点排查。 此外，暖武里府巴革县的巴革学校也在校门口加强了安检措施。巴革警局派出巡逻警力维持秩序，教师们使用物品扫描仪对每名学生的书包进行细致检查。校长能诺表示，学校此前已有常规检查，但此次事件后已将检查升级至最高级别，对进入校园的每一名学生进行扫描排查。她强调，扫描仪学校早已配备使用，但此前仅针对特定目标群体，目前则对所有学生实行全覆盖检查。 针对此前有人在社交媒体群组中发布不当言论一事，校方表示经核查已锁定发帖人。该发帖者已公开道歉，称自己系一时开玩笑、缺乏考虑，并无伤害他人意图。 校长能诺表示，严格检查措施将持续开展。本校始终坚持“人人快乐安全的学校”理念，在教学方面未出现问题，校方为学生安排了丰富有益的活动，班主任亦保持密切关注，并对学生进行100%家访，确保校园安全无虞。 （编译：Wan；来源：Thairath） The post 泰国多校加强校园安检，严防武器入校 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: 中国男子在泰被刺身亡，家属赴芭堤雅呼吁追查真相
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 8月10日上午9时，春武里府芭堤雅市法院门前，一名20岁中国男子曹某的父亲及家属从中国赶赴泰国，就儿子遇害一案跟进进展，呼吁警方全面调查、秉公处理。此前，8月8日清晨，曹某在春武里府梭桃邑县Na Chom Thian乡一处租房内被刺身亡。 当天，死者家属携带中、泰、英三语标语在法院前聚集，神情悲痛。曹某的父亲通过翻译表示，此次来泰是为了了解儿子死亡的全部真相。他坦言，失去养育20年的孩子令他极度痛苦，但依然对泰国的司法程序抱有信心，希望警方逐一核查案件中的每一个疑点。 据家属介绍，事发前，曹某曾与朋友一起用餐约3小时，之后才前往案发租房。其间，一名年轻女子多次通过电话和视频通话联系曹某。午夜过后，曹某前往该租房与该女子见面。家属因此希望警方重点查验手机通讯记录、聊天内容、监控录像，并走访周边证人，以查明曹某为何前往租房及案发前具体发生了什么。同时，家属还请求执法人员核查案发时在场的一名21岁女子的相关信息，综合各项证据澄清所有疑点。 曹某的父亲强调，他不希望社会只听信单方面陈述，恳请执法人员全面核查，让真相水落石出，为儿子讨回公道。 回顾该案，8月8日清晨7时10分，警方接报称一名中国籍男子在Na Chom Thian 30巷的租房内被刺身亡，死者为20岁的曹某。房内发现一名21岁女子，手部被利器割伤，处于惊恐状态。作案嫌疑人为一名20岁男子，系当地某技术学院高职学生，亦为该女子的男友。嫌疑人作案后逃逸，随后在其监护人带领下前往Na Chom Thian警局投案。 警方随后带嫌疑人进行现场供述重演，并以“故意杀人罪”对其提出指控。嫌疑人指认了租房后方一片杂草丛生的丢弃刀具地点，警方使用金属探测器搜寻，发现一把尖头弯身折叠刀，初步认定为作案凶器，已收存作进一步法医鉴定。 在供述重演过程中，抵达现场的中国死者亲属曾试图动手殴打嫌疑人，警方迅速制止并将嫌疑人带离，以防止事态扩大。 据初步调查，嫌疑人供称，其与涉案女子交往约3个月。案发当晚，嫌疑人前往芭堤雅市区工作，清晨返回租房时，发现曹某在房内，遂上前质问并持刀威吓。嫌疑人辩称，曹某试图抢夺刀具，双方发生争执，互相掐颈，最终他夺回刀具并多次刺向曹某，声称并非故意致其死亡。事后，嫌疑人向芭堤雅方向逃逸，得知曹某身亡后决定投案。 涉案女子则向警方表示，她与死者相识并保持联系约2个月。案发当晚，曹某于午夜来到租房找她，两人交谈后睡着，直至清晨男友返回，随即发生争吵与肢体冲突。该女子称，她曾试图上前劝阻，但被刀割伤多处，最终未能阻止悲剧发生。 目前，Na Chom Thian警局正进一步讯问证人、调取监控录像并收集法医证据，以查明案件全部事实，依法追究相关人员法律责任。 （编译：Wan；来源：Siamrath） The post 中国男子在泰被刺身亡，家属赴芭堤雅呼吁追查真相 appeared
title_cn: 中国男子在泰被刺身亡，家属赴芭堤雅呼吁追查真相
summary_cn: 8月8日清晨，20岁中国男子曹某在春武里府梭桃邑县Na Chom Thian乡租房内遭刺身亡。嫌疑人为20岁当地技术学院学生，因与受害者女友产生感情纠葛而行凶。8月10日，曹某家属从中国赶赴芭堤雅，在法院前呼吁警方全面调查。警方以「故意杀人罪」指控嫌疑人并发现作案凶器。
desc_original: 泰国头条新闻社讯 8月10日上午9时，春武里府芭堤雅市法院门前，一名20岁中国男子曹某的父亲及家属从中国赶赴泰国，就儿子遇害一案跟进进展，呼吁警方全面调查、秉公处理。此前，8月8日清晨，曹某在春武里府梭桃邑县Na Chom Thian乡一处租房内被刺身亡。 当天，死者家属携带中、泰、英三语标语在法院前聚集，神情悲痛。曹某的父亲通过翻译表示，此次来泰是为了了解儿子死亡的全部真相。他坦言，失去养育20年的孩子令他极度痛苦，但依然对泰国的司法程序抱有信心，希望警方逐一核查案件中的每一个疑点。 据家属介绍，事发前，曹某曾与朋友一起用餐约3小时，之后才前往案发租房。其间，一名年轻女子多次通过电话和视频通话联系曹某。午夜过后，曹某前往该租房与该女子见面。家属因此希望警方重点查验手机通讯记录、聊天内容、监控录像，并走访周边证人，以查明曹某为何前往租房及案发前具体发生了什么。同时，家属还请求执法人员核查案发时在场的一名21岁女子的相关信息，综合各项证据澄清所有疑点。 曹某的父亲强调，他不希望社会只听信单方面陈述，恳请执法人员全面核查，让真相水落石出，为儿子讨回公道。 回顾该案，8月8日清晨7时10分，警方接报称一名中国籍男子在Na Chom Thian 30巷的租房内被刺身亡，死者为20岁的曹某。房内发现一名21岁女子，手部被利器割伤，处于惊恐状态。作案嫌疑人为一名20岁男子，系当地某技术学院高职学生，亦为该女子的男友。嫌疑人作案后逃逸，随后在其监护人带领下前往Na Chom Thian警局投案。 警方随后带嫌疑人进行现场供述重演，并以“故意杀人罪”对其提出指控。嫌疑人指认了租房后方一片杂草丛生的丢弃刀具地点，警方使用金属探测器搜寻，发现一把尖头弯身折叠刀，初步认定为作案凶器，已收存作进一步法医鉴定。 在供述重演过程中，抵达现场的中国死者亲属曾试图动手殴打嫌疑人，警方迅速制止并将嫌疑人带离，以防止事态扩大。 据初步调查，嫌疑人供称，其与涉案女子交往约3个月。案发当晚，嫌疑人前往芭堤雅市区工作，清晨返回租房时，发现曹某在房内，遂上前质问并持刀威吓。嫌疑人辩称，曹某试图抢夺刀具，双方发生争执，互相掐颈，最终他夺回刀具并多次刺向曹某，声称并非故意致其死亡。事后，嫌疑人向芭堤雅方向逃逸，得知曹某身亡后决定投案。 涉案女子则向警方表示，她与死者相识并保持联系约2个月。案发当晚，曹某于午夜来到租房找她，两人交谈后睡着，直至清晨男友返回，随即发生争吵与肢体冲突。该女子称，她曾试图上前劝阻，但被刀割伤多处，最终未能阻止悲剧发生。 目前，Na Chom Thian警局正进一步讯问证人、调取监控录像并收集法医证据，以查明案件全部事实，依法追究相关人员法律责任。 （编译：Wan；来源：Siamrath） The post 中国男子在泰被刺身亡，家属赴芭堤雅呼吁追查真相 appeared

title: Women built Thailand’s hotel industry, but they still don’t run it
desc: Women built Thailand’s hotel industry, but they still don’t run it Legacy Hospitality has never had a talent problem when it comes to women. It has a seniority problem. Women make up 51.2% of the global hospitality workforce, according to industry data reported by Hospitality Investor in March 2025, yet hold only 30% of executive roles. Thailand’s hotel and tourism sector reflects the same gap, and on 3 September, a new industry platform is aiming directly at it. RISE 2026: Reshaping Hospitality by Empowering Women convenes at SAii Laguna Phuket , organised as a not-for-profit event by C9 Hotelworks, Mrs B Group, and Delivering Asia. The inaugural RISE edition last year drew hospitality professionals from across Thailand for a day of keynotes, workshops, and skills-focused sessions built around the same mission. The program runs across four themes: Vision and Voice, Systems and Sectors, Emerging Leaders, and Craft, Communication and Self. Three of the women speaking at RISE make the business case better than any statistic: Lily Udomkunnatum, Managing Director of Burasiri Hotel Group, has built and run a hotel company from the ownership side, not just operated one

desc: Injured Russian woman flees across border to seek help from Chiang Rai police Legacy A Russian woman received assistance from Thai police yesterday, August 9, after reportedly fleeing across the border into Chiang Rai to escape physical assault in Myanmar . Police are investigating possible links to a call centre scam gang. Officers from Mae Sai Police Station were called to a supermarket car park after the Russian woman was found with injuries to her arms and legs. title: Why Thais give jasmine to their mothers and what the flower actually represents
desc: Why Thais give jasmine to their mothers and what the flower actually represents Legacy Every August in Thailand, jasmine appears everywhere. As garlands, brooches, small bouquets, and school ceremony gifts, the small white flower is passed from children to mothers on August 12. To understand why, you need to understand two things: the date itself, and what jasmine means to Thai culture. A day tied to the Mother of the Nation Thailand’s National Mother’s Day has always been more than a family occasion. It was tied directly to Her Majesty Queen Sirikit, the Queen Mother, regarded as the Mother of the Nation, and the day carries that weight alongside the more personal act of honouring one’s own mother. Queen Sirikit passed away on October 24, 2025, at the age of 93. This year’s Mother’s Day is the first since her passing, and the occasion carries particular significance as a result. The tradition she inspired, of Thais honouring their mothers with jasmine and gratitude, continues as a living expression of the values she embodied. Her influence on Thai culture and the depth of affection Thais held for her is hard to separate from the holiday itself. Queen

title: Interior Ministry investigates Thai citizenship of Israeli national in Phuket
desc: Interior Ministry investigates Thai citizenship of Israeli national in Phuket Legacy The Ministry of Interior is investigating the Thai citizenship of an Israeli national in Phuket and a business reportedly linked to him after questions over the legality of his citizenship. Phuket Times reported yesterday, August 9, that the Israeli national had obtained Thai citizenship and a Thai identification card and was operating businesses in Phuket that reportedly generated more than 5 billion baht in revenue. The report described the man as a major businessman and spiritual and religious leader and alleged that his Thai nationality had enabled his business activities. It also linked him to the founder of a Chabad centre, where the report claimed Thai people and officials were prevented from entering. The report said residents had raised concerns about the number of Israeli nationals in Patong, particularly around Rat Uthit 200 Years Road. Photo by gyro via Getty Images According to the report, businesses in the area include kosher restaurants, hotels, convenience stores, laundry shops, barbers, gyms, car rental businesses, travel agencies and other services catering to Israeli nationals.
